intro: New Year's Eve and New Year's Day are the biggest secular turn of the calendar — the countdown to midnight, fireworks, champagne toasts, and messages wishing everyone a fresh start for the year ahead. This page gathers everything for styling that message: curated fonts you can preview on your own text, the fireworks-and-clock emoji people actually paste, kaomoji for a celebratory chat message, a few original ASCII art pieces, and a phrase bank of ready-made greetings that style instantly when you tap them.
date_window: the night of Dec 31 into Jan 1 — the same Gregorian-calendar date every year, worldwide
